changelog:
Shadow Rivals Alpha 1.13:
- Android & Mac ports with native touch controls
- Auto-update checker on Android
- Cross-platform account linking
- 18 Defuse maps including 6 new community maps
- 33 game skins with full body rendering
- Draft system for Defuse with per-team map voting
- Copter upgrade system with 41 variants
- Player upgrade system with superpowers
- Kill combo system with money economy
- In-room lobby with procedural minimap previews
- Unified team names/colors for all modes
